entities.name: Robert Nettleton Field
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Robert Nettleton Field was a New Zealand artist, sculptor, potter and art teacher. He was born in Bromley, Kent, England on 3 March 1899. Field was described as "a quiet man who has never sought publicity and makes the most
modest claims for himself."
